root_cause: Category=Context is reserved by UE StateTree for automatic object/struct context binding; the four fixed integer/enum settings were incorrectly classified as context.
fix: Change all four fields on both Actor and Mass condition structs to Category=Condition, which UE classifies as Parameter.
asset_delivery: Refresh existing compiled trees in place, check editor graph hash unchanged, and inspect actual FProperty metadata through the UE StateTree usage helper.
